task_scope.start: all arms are at all/plug2, the camera arm is at mid/plug2, and the right gripper already holds the plug near the target socket
task_scope.end: plug is mechanically seated in the intended socket
excluded: camera or gripper remounting within the cohort

fixed_geometry.initial_image_source: mid/left/right images saved with all/plug2 and mid/plug2; exact paths and hashes pending readback

model_slot_policy.left: left-arm camera view; left arm remains fixed at all/plug2

scene_distribution.rule: positions and probabilities are frozen before the first accepted demonstration

terminal_labels.success: plug is mechanically seated in the intended socket
terminal_labels.failure: episode is valid but the plug is not seated when the operator terminates it
terminal_labels.aborted: operator cancellation, hardware fault, stale camera, invalid reset, or invalid recording; excluded from formal replay
terminal_labels.autonomous_success: success with no HIL during the episode
terminal_labels.hil_success: success after any human takeover; retained with HUMAN/MIXED source and never counted as autonomous success

hil_contract.purpose: safety or correction of a still-recoverable deviation
do_not_intervene: before the policy has made a meaningful decision solely to manufacture a success
after an unrecoverable collision solely to relabel the episode as success
hil_contract.release_behavior: episode remains paused until an explicit operator decision

reference_evidence.notes: Pose names and the three intended views are defined by the operator. Exact files, hashes, joint values, topic rates, mount marks and scene positions remain pending onsite readback.
reference_evidence.operator_statement: On 2026-09-23 the operator selected all/plug2 and mid/plug2 as the initial poses; observations use mid, left-arm, and right-arm cameras while control/proprio use only the right arm.

expert_collection_contract.label_rule: A complete committed expert episode is implicitly success=true; no separate success button is required.
